visualize_tracks_on_video: create a Visualizer instance and call visualize to draw object tracking points and trajectories on video frames
read_video_from_path: read a video file from disk path and return stacked numpy array of frames using imageio
draw_circle_on_image: draw a colored circle at specified coordinates on a PIL image with configurable radius and alpha
draw_line_on_image: draw a colored line between two coordinate points on a PIL image with configurable linewidth
save_video_from_tensor: save a tensor video as an MP4 file to disk using imageio with configurable FPS
